correctness.rationale: Two finite enumerations (interval recursion and independently encoded Dyck/stack matching) exhaust precisely \(C_9=4862\) noncrossing matchings. Equality or strict interleaving of chord endpoints characterizes prohibited neighbour edges. Pairwise chord-bitmask scans and forbidden-chord dynamic generation yield the same complete graph fingerprint 81631930f2db82172b1509c4f558f1933749e4b263323c00c58fdcae6eed97cb. BFS from all 4070 big-component vertices proves exactly the six eccentricity multiplicities, unique centers, radius 10 and diameter 15. Program inputs are only exact integers, and the proof establishes completeness of each finite loop. No claim extends beyond nine pairs.

value.rationale: Nine pairs form the first parameter in the stable three-type component regime established by the 2015 primary paper. The 4070-vertex big component was previously classified by size, but not by transformation distances. The exact radius, diameter, uniquely central two boundary matchings and full eccentricity spectrum answer natural reachability-efficiency questions and connect the old maximum-degree rings with a genuinely different metric extremality. This is a motivated exact natural cutoff, not an arbitrary slice or known-table recomputation; no general theorem is claimed.
